purpose: Eligible pool and recording obligations for the adversarial reconstructor's auxiliary corpus.

eligible_pool.description: Public documents under a license permitting local evaluation and, where the task manifest binds the right, transmission to the pinned model provider.
eligible_pool.constraint: No customer, employer-confidential, or collaborator-private material is eligible without a separate explicit owner authorization bound into the manifest.

eligible_pool.description: Deterministic dictionaries covering the frozen transformation families: exact, nfd, nfkc, hex, base64, percent, json_escape, delimiter, fragmentation, case, whitespace, reversible_composition.
Synthetic records whose join keys deterministically chain auxiliary evidence to at most one canary value, so a correlated recovery is mechanically decidable.
Synthetic near-miss records that must not produce a positive recovery; they bound the reconstructor's false-positive rate.

manifest_binding: The experiment manifest binds the auxiliary-corpus digest alongside the threat-model and attack-catalog digests and the sealed canary-registry ciphertext metadata.
adjudication: Tester and reconstructor emit independent content-addressed findings before seeing one another's conclusions. The Validator adjudicates only by the frozen mechanical recovery rule; an underdetermined dispute is INVALID_HARNESS.
note: This file is a request and a recording contract. The Tester does not select the corpus; selecting it here would defeat the independence the threat model requires.
